name: v0.3.20 — mobile product images · love-count engine · Spending Trend + Worth It? charts
releaseNotes:
• Stash cards on mobile now show real product photos (cauliflower → cauliflower image, mint → mint image, etc.) via a new Dart service hitting the same /api/product-image-batch endpoint web uses.
• Heart icon on Stash cards now shows aggregate love count + toggles like in real-time. Tap once to ♥, tap again to unlike. Engine centralized (web/src/lib/productLikes.js + mobile/lib/services/product_likes_service.dart) with a SECURITY DEFINER RPC for privacy-preserving aggregate counts. Requires migration_062_product_likes.sql applied in Supabase.
• Mobile /guacanomics gains TWO chart cards: Spending Trend (fl_chart line, monthly $) and Worth It? donut (rating distribution by spend with 5 GuacScore-band slices + center total). Matches web's Charts component for /guacanomics.
• Item card contract picks up new props — loveCount, likedByMe, onToggleLove — fully documented in test-fixtures/item-card-scenarios.json. The dev showcase at /_dev/item-card renders 21 scenarios for visual audit.
